entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. G. N. Rout, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Arindam Sinha
 Justice Sanjay Kumar Mishra
 Order
29.03.2023 Order No.
01. 1.
Mr. Rath, learned advocate appears on behalf of petitioners and submits, his clients are street vendors.
They vend fast food at Unit-2, Market Building in Bhubaneswar city.

His clients have disclosed, inter alia, provisional certificates of trade licence valid till 31st March, 2023 and other certificates issued by Health and Family Welfare Department, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: His clients apprehend eviction and demolition of their shops.

Hence, they have prayed that in case of eviction, they may kindly be relocated in nearby place in terms of the provisions in Street Vendors (Protection of livelihood and regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014.

entities.text: Street Vendors (Protection of livelihood and regulation
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Rout, learned advocate, Additional Standing Counsel appears on behalf of State.

3. We are inclined to dispose of the writ petition without directing issuance of notice on opposite party nos.2 to 5 because we are convinced Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation (BMC), having had issued provisional trade licence to petitioners for doing their business at the location, is aware of their existence.
The Act of 2014 does provide protection to street vendors.
In the circumstances, in event BMC proceeds to evict petitioners, it must be in accordance with law.
4. The writ petition is disposed of.
